definition_of_done: Unit tests added for all new/changed code; HTTP calls mocked with respx — no live Jira access in tests (CLAUDE.md “the three non-negotiables” #3).

If a Jira operation was added or changed: a typed client.py method AND a matching tools.py Tool entry (pydantic args model), both reachable via `symphony-workflow list-tools`/`call` (CLAUDE.md “the three non-negotiables” #2).
A Typer CLI subcommand added only if a human needs a friendly entry point for it — not every tool needs one (CLAUDE.md “Adding a new tool”, step 4).
`uv run ruff check .` and `uv run ruff format --check .` both pass clean (CLAUDE.md “Code style”).
`uv run pytest` passes in full (CLAUDE.md “the three non-negotiables” #3).
Type hints on all new code; pydantic models for anything crossing a boundary such as an HTTP response or tool input (CLAUDE.md “Code style”).
No bare `except Exception: pass`; typed exceptions (e.g. JiraError) caught specifically (CLAUDE.md “Code style”).

No org-specific values (cloud-f1.atlassian.net, CF1 field IDs, ADLC, a hardcoded target-repo path) baked into client.py/orchestrator.py/poller.py — configuration goes through env vars (CLAUDE.md “What NOT to do here”).
